requisitionList.Title: Freight Handler- Full Time- 2nd Shift
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Forklift Operator is responsible for the safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, staging, scanning, and movement of freight. As certified forklift operators within the operation, they provide safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, movement, and documentation of cargo/freight within a multimodal transportation terminal, intermodal yard, warehouse, or dock environment, directly contributing to productivity, workflow coordination, and freight integrity. As the most experienced team members without direct reports, they often assist with mentoring, guiding, and onboarding new Material Handlers and solving complex operational problems on the floor.

requisitionList.Title: Operations Dock Supervisor
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Forward Air is seeking a capable and career-oriented Dock Supervisor to lead our fast-paced shipping/dock operation. The qualified candidate will coordinate all activities of dockworkers, drivers and other support personnel. The supervisor will provide planning for, direction to, and will control available resources associated with the timely, damage-free, and safe loading/unloading of freight on assigned shifts. In addition, the supervisor will provide dockworker and driver training, performance feedback, and provide disciplinary recommendations when necessary. Previous experience with cargo operations is a plus.

requisitionList.Title: Agent Operations Coordinator-logistics
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Forward is seeking self-motivated individuals to successfully oversee our agent terminal operations. This role is responsible for identifying, communicating and coordination specific market needs between various departments and management levels. The specialist handles issues that can occur before, during and after the time of service, adapting existing processes and providing recommendations for existing agreements. They engage closely with our agent terminal operations to ensure timely freight availability, departure and daily operational KPIs are met. This position maintains professional and collaborative working relationships with multiple departments and management levels to support their service needs while providing a superior level of support.

requisitionList.Title: Warehouse Associate
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Warehouse Associate is responsible for daily customer order fulfillment activities within an assigned facility. They are cross-trained in multiple warehouse disciplines and are responsible for supporting warehouse operations and administrative functions, including receiving, order filling, picking, packing, shipping, returns, replenishment, inventory, and value-added service. They play a key role in ensuring inventory is handled safely, accurately, and efficiently while supporting the flow of operational documentation and information from warehouse offices. They work closely with site leaders, carriers, drivers, and internal support teams to maintain safety, productivity, accuracy, and service quality.

requisitionList.Title: Customer Relations Coordinator-logistics
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Customer Relations Coordinator provides front‑line administrative and customer service support to ensure accurate shipment processing, documentation, and communication within a transportation terminal or contract logistics site. They serve as a primary point of contact for customers, carriers, drivers, and internal teams, helping ensure shipments move smoothly and customers receive timely, accurate updates. They are responsible for scheduling, shipment tracking and tracing, customer support, documentation, and core financial activities such as accounts receivable, accounts payable, and billing. They interact closely with customers, drivers, carriers, and operational teams to support the timely movement of freight across logistics networks and may assist with freight acceptance and basic cartage support where applicable.

requisitionList.Title: Industrial Engineer - Contract Logistics
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Industrial Engineer is responsible for analyzing, designing, optimizing, and implementing processes, workflows, facility layouts, and operating models that improve efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and service performance across logistics and transportation operations. They work closely with operations leaders to identify improvement opportunities and develop scalable solutions that support business growth and operational excellence. They apply engineering principles, data analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies to enhance performance across warehousing, transportation, freight forwarding, terminal, and distribution environments. They serve as a technical subject matter expert, translating business needs into practical operational solutions that improve throughput, resource utilization, customer experience, and cost performance.

requisitionList.Title: Dispatcher - Local
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Dispatcher - Local supports day‑to‑day freight coordination by following established procedures to schedule, assign, and track shipments. This role focuses on accurately entering information, monitoring shipment progress, and communicating routine updates between drivers and internal teams. The Dispatcher provides direct support to Independent Contractors by responding to questions, relaying instructions, and escalating issues to leadership as needed. Work is performed within defined guidelines, SOPs, and systems. This position plays a critical role in maintaining timely, accurate freight movement and exceptional driver and customer service.

requisitionList.Title: Operations Supervisor
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Operations Supervisor is responsible for leading day-to-day activities across contract logistics operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and accurate execution of core service processes. This role provides direct leadership to frontline associates and is accountable for operational performance, safety, quality, and customer service within the assigned function, area, or shift. They drive productivity, adherence to standard work, and continuous improvement while supporting customer commitments and operational excellence goals. They play a critical role in problem-solving, process optimization, and issue resolution in fast-paced operational environments.

The role owns the relationship with our valued Independent Contractors and is instrumental in the successful coordination of the accurate delivery of goods in a timely fashion. The key responsibilities of this function are to provide exceptional support to our drivers, be quick to respond to questions and troubleshooting concerns and to pro-actively monitor the movement of freight to ensure customer satisfaction.

requisitionList.Title: Carrier Operations Coordinator - Pickup and Delivery

Working closely with internal teams and external partners, they are central to delivering a smooth and reliable customer experience. This is an excellent entry point for individuals looking to build a career in supply chain and logistics.
